description: What account deletion (requestAccountDeletion) does with every registered Firestore collection that can hold a person's uid. tool/contracts/check_account_deletion_erasure.mjs fails when such a collection has no entry. handling: deleted (the person's documents are removed; references in other people's documents may be anonymised as 'how' says), anonymised (the documents stay without the person's uid or identity), kept (with a reason; needsDecision marks a gap the owner has not decided), notPersonal (with a reason). A deleted or anonymised entry must be written by a handler file: handledBy, or the handlers list.
